question: What basis enables the best of Raghus to perform all ritual acts?
premises: The mātṛkā letters serve as the foundation
Resorting to them precedes ritual action
All acts are to be performed on this basis
inference: By taking refuge in the mātṛkā letters, the practitioner can accomplish all prescribed rites.
plain_english: Having resorted to the letters of Mātṛkā, the best of the Raghus should perform everything.
